description: This file sets up Express.js route handlers for master data entities like customers, vendors, bank accounts, tax rates, and currencies. It defines routes for listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting these master records, with associated middleware for authentication and authorization.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handler for listing master records of a specified entity.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handler for creating a new master record for a specified entity.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Handler for retrieving a specific master record by ID.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handler for updating a specific master record by ID.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Handler for deleting a specific master record by ID.
